basis: Repository deliverable maturity, not personal effort, authorship share, or an official course grade. Approximate reviewer judgment.
formula: Eight owner deliverables x 10 points (80 total) plus four shared deliverables x 5 points (20 total). Each receives stage/4 of its weight.

rubric.0: No substantive required output / not started
rubric.1: Prepared specification or materials; required execution/results absent
rubric.2: Implemented and unit/offline verified, or only part of a multi-part deliverable exists
rubric.3: Real-data pilot or partial target coverage verified; final acceptance remains
rubric.4: Defined deliverable implemented and verified within its stated scope
